import numpy as np

# Load the data

    'QuarCd': [72, 72, 101, 101, 101],
    'QuarLang': ['Hottingen', 'Hottingen', 'Höngg', 'Höngg', 'Höngg'],
    'QuarSort': [72, 72, 101, 101, 101],
    'Rasse1Text': ['Deutsche Dogge', 'Deutsche Dogge', 'Continental Bulldog', 'Continental Bulldog', 'Continental Bulldog'],
    'Rasse2Text': ['Labrador Retriever', 'Labrador Retriever', '', '', ''],
    'Rassetyp1Cd': ['I', 'I', 'I', 'I', 'I'],

    'Rassetyp1Sort': [2, 2, 2, 2, 2],
    'Rassetyp2Cd': ['I', 'I', 'UN', 'UN', 'UN'],
    'Rassetyp2Lang': ['Rassentypenliste I', 'Rassentypenliste I', 'Unbekannt', 'Unbekannt', 'Unbekannt'],
    'Rassetyp2Sort': [2, 2, 5, 5, 5],
    'GebHundDatJahr': [2020, 2020, 2019, 2019, 2019],
    'AlterVHundCd': [4, 5, 0, 1, 2],

    'SexHundCd': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],

    'HundefarbeText': ['beige', 'beige', 'beige/schwarz', 'beige/schwarz', 'beige/schwarz'],
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Dog age distribution by year
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
sns.lineplot(data=df, x='StichtagDatJahr', y='AlterVHundNum', hue='HID', 
             marker='o', linewidth=2.5, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Dog Age Progression by Registration Year')
ax1.set_xlabel('Registration Year')
ax1.set_ylabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(title='Dog ID')

# 2. Breed distribution
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(breed_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(breed_counts.values, labels=breed_counts.index,

ax2.set_title('Primary Breed Distribution')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. District and quarter distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
district_data = df.groupby(['KreisLang', 'QuarLang']).size().reset_index(name='Count')
sns.barplot(data=district_data, x='KreisLang', y='Count', hue='QuarLang', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_title('Registrations by District and Quarter')
ax3.set_xlabel('District')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.legend(title='Quarter')

# 4. Dog color distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts()
sns.barplot(x=color_counts.index, y=color_counts.values, ax=ax4, palette='viridis')
ax4.set_title('Dog Color Distribution')
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Color')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add summary statistics as text
summary_text = f"""
Dataset Summary:
- Total records: {len(df)}
- Unique dogs: {df['HID'].nunique()}
- Districts represented: {df['KreisLang'].nunique()}
- Primary breeds: {df['Rasse1Text'].nunique()}
- Age range: {df['AlterVHundNum'].min():.1f} - {df['AlterVHundNum'].max():.1f} years
- All owners: {df['AlterV10Lang'].iloc[0]}
- All dogs: {df['SexHundLang'].iloc[0]}
"""
fig.text(0.02, 0.02, summary_text, fontsize=10, verticalalignment='bottom',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.1, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
